# Command reference

This reference is generated from the `adt` command tree, including the first-party command plugins (ATC, AUnit, codegen, diff, export, flow). It always matches the released CLI; run `adt <command> --help` for the same information in your terminal.

## Global options

Accepted by every command, anywhere on the command line.

| Option                       | Description                                                                                                                    | Default      |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------ |
| `-V, --version`              | output the version number                                                                                                      |              |
| `--sid <sid>`                | SAP System ID (e.g., TRL) - overrides default system                                                                           |              |
| `-v, --verbose [components]` | Enable verbose logging. Optionally filter by components: auth, connection, cts, atc, repository, discovery, http, cli or 'all' |              |
| `--log-level <level>`        | Log level: trace\|debug\|info\|warn\|error                                                                                     | `info`       |
| `--log-output <dir>`         | Output directory for log files                                                                                                 | `./tmp/logs` |
| `--log-response-files`       | Save ADT responses as separate files                                                                                           | `false`      |
| `--config <path>`            | Path to config file (default: adt.config.ts, or .adt/config.ts if present)                                                     |              |
